title: V2 multi-candidate workflow
content: V2 must plan 1 to 3 independent enhancement candidates, execute each candidate on the same original input image, evaluate each real output, rank by final_score, then diagnose residual degradation before completion.

title: planning_score is not final_score
content: planning_score is only a pre-inference candidate planning signal. It must not be reported or used as final image quality. final_score must come after real model output evaluation.

title: No serial enhancement
content: Enhancement candidates must be independent. Do not run Retinexformer output through DarkIR or HVI-CIDNet as a serial enhancement chain in the current V2 workflow. Do not fuse candidate pixels.

title: Multimodal AI is advisory
content: Multimodal AI and retrieved context can only provide bounded semantic hints. They cannot directly select the final model, bypass ModelRegistry, bypass HardwareInspector, override hard quality rejection, or load checkpoints.
